avis.titre: I have bought countless bottles of this product.

avis.titre: My Face feels so soft, and clean!

I have tried Neutrogena Hydro Boost Exfoliating Cleanser in the past and it was nice. I'm not big of physical exfoliants, but this one is pretty good. The tiny micro beads help to slough away dead skin cells softly without too much rubbing. I never experienced any dryness, irritation, or flaking from use of this product. After use your skin feels soft, hydrated, and smooth. I would definitely recommend this product for anyone who doesn't mind a physical exfoliants.

I use this a couple times a week as a light exfoliater inbetween the Hydroboost gel cleanser. It's very gentle, moisturizing, gets my makeup off and has a light, refreshing scent. It lathers well and a little goes a long way.

avis.titre: If you haven't tried this yet, you should!
avis.texte: This is a great product that delivers results! Work it into a lather and apply to dampened skin. You may feel a little bit of tightness but that is just results you are feeling and it isn't overwhelming. I highly recommend.
It's perfect for my morning routine. It comes out very nice and easy. I haven't had any breakouts using this product. The scent is light not overwhelming. Super easy to rinse off.
I love this cleansing gel, it has a natural smell and it leave my face feeling fresh and tight. And I always top it off with the moisturizer. This line works incredibly at keeping your skin hydrated

avis.titre: Fresh, smooth skin with no breakouts for me - just
avis.texte: I've been using the Neutrogena Hydro Boost Exfoliating Cleanser and it leaves my skin feeling really fresh, clean and smooth. The gel texture feels light and the hyaluronic acid helps it feel more hydrated compared to some other cleansers. I didn't notice any new breakouts while using it, and my skin felt soft after rinsing. That said, because it has gentle exfoliating bits, I wouldn't personally use it every single day on sensitive days as it can feel slightly drying/tight if overused. Overall a great affordable cleanser for a clean glow!

I am not crazy about exfoliating products for my face because they tend to make my face break out. I will have to say that this product was wonderful. I had no breakouts and it made it feel so smooth afterwards.
I really love this product, clean my face very well, after using it my skin feel soft and looks more shiny. I use this maybe 3 times per week, I like to alternate with other products
10/10 cleanser!!! Have repurchased several times. Works for all skin types. Leaves my skin feeling hydrated. Love everything from this line of products

I have used this affordable exfoliating cleanser for the past few years as part of my skincare routine. I have sensitive skin and have no issues with this product. The gel is easy to use, provides gentle exfoliation and makes my skin feel clean & refreshed, not stripped.

My skin feels clean, soft, and refreshed after every use. A must-have for a gentle yet effective daily cleanse!" It leaves no residue and my skin is free from large pores and breakouts as it removes all black heads , white heads and oil from my skin.
I absolutely love this face wash and i pair the Neutrogena hydro gel moisturizer and if you have really dry skin THIS IS FOR YOU! I want to try everything from this line

avis.titre: Value money & great product. Easy to use
avis.texte: Easy to use. Always recommended to perform a small test on a small area of the face. Leaves the skin well hydrated. The packaging is easy to carry and store.

I've been using the Neutrogena Hydro Boost Exfoliating Cleanser, and I'm honestly so impressed. The scent is clean, light, and fresh. The texture is a smooth gel with gentle exfoliating beads, so it never feels harsh. It glides on comfortably, foams lightly, and rinses off without leaving any tightness or residue. Instead, my skin feels super clean, soft, and hydrated, not stripped. As someone with combination skin, this was such a win. It helps keep my T-zone balanced and smooth while still giving enough moisture for the drier areas. After each wash, my face feels refreshed, glowing, and comfortably hydrated.

avis.titre: Great cleanser for gentle physical exfoliation
avis.texte: Great cleanser with gentle exfoliating beads. I tend to use it at night when I need physical exfoliation. Refreshing scent. Leaves face feeling fresh without oily residue and without over-drying.

I absolutely this cleanser! It works great and makes my face feel super clean. I have had no breakouts since using it. My face feels moisturized and soft! This cleanser does not leave any weird feeling or residue after using as well.

avis.titre: A gentle daily exfoliating cleanser that cleans we
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using the Neutrogena Hydro Boost Exfoliating Cleanser. The gel-cream texture feels very soft and gentle on the skin, and the exfoliating beads are mild enough for daily use without causing irritation. It rinses off easily and leaves my face feeling clean, smooth, and hydrated rather than tight. I love that it contains hyaluronic acid — it helps keep my skin moisturized even after cleansing. It works well for my combination skin and feels refreshing every time I use it. Overall, it's a great everyday exfoliating cleanser that gives a clean but comfortable finish!!!!!
This is pretty good on dry skin. I have sensitive skin, but it doesn't make it blotchy. It's good to take for travel instead of my more expensive facial wash. Easy to rinse off.

Neutrogena hydroboost gel cream exfoliator works pretty well for a physical exfoliant. I myself prefer an acid based exfoliator, but, if the job needs to be done real quick, this physical exfoliant is a gentle substitute that helps to eliminate dead skin while leaving your skin silky smooth, plump, and hydrated. The gel-cream has a light and fresh seaside sort of scent, that's not over the top, but it's there, if you're not into your skincare products having a scent. This exfoliating beads feel gentle enough that you shouldn't have to worry about micro tears in your skin and it washes off completely without leaving any lingering residue. Overall, I like it for a physical exfoliant and would definitely use it again, if it were needed!!

This line from Neutrogena is absolutely wonderful. Super exfoliating and perfect for all skin types. It gives you a daily boost that feels alike. Moisture has been implanted into your skin. It leaves you with a fresh feeling.
I love this face wash! It makes my face feel so clean after I use it and i feel super refreshed. I've bought it a few times already and will continue to purchase it.

Scent is good with great absorption. Love the texture on this one, great appearance with light texture. Easy cleansing, money for value and no irritation. Will definitely be repurchasing it!! Absolute gem
Lightweight gel cleanser with hyaluronic acid that removes dirt and makeup while leaving skin feeling clean and hydrated, not tight. Ideal for travel or everyday use.
This cleanser is great for exfoliating and keeping your face clean. It's a creamy texture and doesn't foam. I like that it has Hyaluronic acid which is great for the skin.

I don't experience any breakouts, which can be difficult to find in other brands (I can breakout easily). This is an essential product in my skincare routine!
Have tried this awhile back liked how it felt cleaning my skin and not leaving an oily residue behind. It lathers great and keeps my skin feeling soft and clear.

avis.titre: Smells great and leaves your skin soft at an affor

I gave this one 5 stars because it's inexpensive and leaves my skin soft and hydrated, but I also don't think it ever made a real difference either in my skin's appearance or overall health. It's a decent cleanser, but don't expect any big changes to your skin either.

It leaves my face clean, soft, and fresh, without that tight feeling some exfoliating cleansers give. Plus, it's clean skincare, which is always a bonus! If you have normal to oily skin, I think this could be a great daily cleanser, but for drier skin, it's better as an occasional exfoliator.

avis.titre: Decent one for normal to oily skin type.
avis.texte: I tried the Neutrogena Hydro Boost Exfoliating Cleanser, and it's a decent daily cleanser with mild exfoliation. It has a gel-like texture with tiny beads and lathers well. While it cleans thoroughly without being too harsh, it's not as hydrating as I expected. My skin feels fresh but slightly tight afterward, so I always need a moisturizer. It didn't cause major irritation despite my sensitive skin, but the added fragrance and sulfates might not suit everyone. Overall, it's a good option for normal to oily skin but may not be the best for very dry or sensitive skin. Rating: ⭐⭐⭐☆☆ (3/5)
